ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - PCHunter Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious use of PCHunter, a tool like Process Hacker to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level stuff

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\PCHunter64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PCHunter32\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PCHunter\.exe" OR process_description = "Epoolsoft\ Windows\ Information\ View\ Tools") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=5F1CBC3D99558307BC1250D084FA968521482025.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=987B65CD9B9F4E9A1AFD8F8B48CF64A7.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=2B214BDDAAB130C274DE6204AF6DBA5AEEC7433DA99AA950022FA306421A6D32.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=444D210CEA1FF8112F256A4997EED7FF.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=3FB89787CB97D902780DA080545584D97FB1C2EB.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=228DD0C2E6287547E26FFBD973A40F14.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=55F041BF4E78E9BFA6D4EE68BE40E496CE3A1353E1CA4306598589E19802522C.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0479F44DF47CFA2EF1CCC4416A538663.*")))
